zh: 只有值在闭区间 [−100, 100] 内的元素才参与计算，其余元素直接忽略，但它们仍占着自己的下标。
按 0 基下标的奇偶分成两组：偶数下标的合格元素加到一个和里，奇数下标的加到另一个和里，答案是前者减后者。
一次遍历：对第 i 个元素，若 −100 ≤ x ≤ 100，就按 i 的奇偶加到 even 或 odd；最后输出 even − odd。注意下标按原数组位置算，不是按过滤后的位置。
en: Only elements whose value lies in the closed interval [-100, 100] take part; the others are ignored, but they still occupy their indices.
Split by the parity of the 0-based index: qualifying elements at even indices go into one sum and those at odd indices into another, and the answer is the first minus the second.

Scan once: for element i, if -100 <= x <= 100, add it to even or odd according to the parity of i; finally print even - odd. The parity uses the position in the original array, not in the filtered list.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the array once; add only the values in [-100,100] to the sum matching the parity of their index, and take the difference at the end.

## Proof of correctness

Each element is counted if and only if its value falls in the closed interval, and it goes into the sum for the parity of its real index; at the end of the scan the two sums are exactly as defined, so outputting their difference is correct.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
